clusters.name: iteration-profile-and-sccache
clusters.executionModeRationale: All four stories edit the same two markdown files (publish-sandbox-patch.md, CLAUDE.md). Parallel execution would force merge resolution on every story for trivial gains. Serial execution in US-1 -> US-2 -> US-3a -> US-4 order avoids merge conflicts and keeps the change reviewable as a single coherent PR. US-3b (recorded benchmark numbers) is split out as an operator-driven follow-up task (codex-rs-build-perf-baseline-measurement) and is NOT part of this plan.
